generation.explanation: An inscribed angle is half the measure of the arc it intercepts. Drag P along the same arc between the fixed endpoints A and B: the triangle changes, but the angle at P stays constant. If P crosses an endpoint onto the other arc, the angle switches to its supplementary angle—here, from 60° to 120°.
